subject: Ruby Fernandez — technical window and run-of-show
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Ruby Fernandez <ruby.fernandez@example.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Ruby Fernandez — technical window and run-of-show

Hi Ruby —

Thanks for applying and for the great conversation with Laura yesterday. We'd like to schedule your technical session (ML + coding hybrid) with our team. Below are three 90-minute windows — each includes a short system-design + 45m coding challenge (CoderPad) and a 15m debrief. Please confirm which option works best in PT; we can pivot for timezones.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Oct 12 — 13:00–14:30 PT
- Wed Oct 13 — 10:00–11:30 PT
- Thu Oct 14 — 16:00–17:30 PT

Run-of-show (brief):
- 5m intro + TLDR
- 25m systems/ML design (Kimberly)
- 45m coding challenge (Marcus via CoderPad)
- 15m candidate questions + wrap

Logistics:
- CoderPad link: https://codercoderpad.example/session/7f3a (we'll open the pad at the start)
- Zoom bridge: meeting link will be created once we lock the slot (recording on with consent)
- Please attach an updated resume if anything changed (I attached the latest copy I have below).

Attachments: RubyFernandez_resume.pdf

If you have accessibility needs or prefer a whiteboard-only session, let me know and we'll adjust.

Best,
Ava Chen
Recruiting Coordinator, Redwood Inference

--

+1 to Tue Oct 12 1pm PT. Locking in the block on my calendar.

Quick ops notes for the panel (copying details into our interviewer checklist):
- CoderPad session (linked by Ava) — Marcus will own the prompt and be ready to hit share at start. Pad supports Node/Go/Python; Ruby prefers Python per the earlier notes.
- Zoom: I'll create the meeting and set a passcode. We'll ask Ruby for consent to record in the first minute — if declined we'll still take notes.
- Recording consent wording: "Hi Ruby — quick ask: we record the technical session to share with the feedback panel. Is that OK?"

Marcus — can you prep the backing test harness (stdin/time-limit) so we get the candidate into the warm-up quicker? Also flag any system constraints (e.g., no internet allowed during the coding portion).

Thanks — I'll paste the finalized Zoom + CoderPad links once Ava confirms slot officially.

Kimberly Park
